tips.text: Buy or borrow two Smeeta imprints to lock the breed instead of re-rolling Random Incubations.
Budget 30 or more codes in total; every Adarza roll costs another 10 codes and another Power Core.
Expect the codes to be the tedious part, from about 45 minutes with a full setup to several hours without one.
Expect a good companion, not a mandatory one, since the Charm rework; any beast with Resourceful Retriever matches its resource yield.
